title: Router consumes CAP evidence and cost per success
observation: Capability records (task family x role x provider x resolved model x effort x toolset, Wilson intervals, cost per success) are written by `orchestrate capability`, but router.select still ranks by static relative cost per tier. Bootstrap evidence (FND-0003) showed the cheapest tier was 2.6x more expensive per success than the workhorse on one task. Tracks MIE-0008.
suggested_direction: Give select() an optional task_family; when qualified CAP records exist (Wilson lower bound >= policy floor, >= min samples), prefer the lowest measured cost per success among qualified routes; otherwise keep today's ordering. Record the evidence id in the selection explanation.
acceptance: Without CAP records routing is unchanged (existing router tests pass)
With qualified records the cheapest qualified route wins and the explanation cites the CAP id
Unqualified (tiny-sample) records never override the default
